actions.input:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
benef = pd.read_csv('beneficiaries.csv')
pay = pd.read_excel('payments.xlsx', sheet_name='Disbursements', header=4)
# clean status
pay['Status_clean'] = pay['Status'].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
pay_paid = pay[pay['Status_clean']=='paid'].copy()
# ensure Beneficiary ID exists in beneficiaries
benef_ids = set(benef['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip())
pay_paid = pay_paid[pay_paid['Beneficiary ID'].astype(str).str.strip().isin(benef_ids)]
# merge
merged = pay_paid.merge(benef[['Beneficiary ID','Programme']], on='Beneficiary ID', how='inner')
# sum amount
amount_col = 'Amount (INR)'
# ensure numeric
merged[amount_col] = pd.to_numeric(merged[amount_col], errors='coerce')
totals = merged.groupby('Programme')[amount_col].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(totals)
print('Highest:', totals.index[0], totals.iloc[0])
\""
